evidence.art: 001/003 title + 005-018 film paintings and 040-048 gate plate (moonlit Nile, carved pylons, bronze jackals) are near-AAA; plastic 3D bodies in 020-048 do not share the painted lit style.
evidence.continuity: Film Anpu 016-018 has gold-trimmed regalia, big ankh, jackal-headed sceptre; in-game Anpu 040-046 is black-legged, white kilt, tiny ankh, plain forked sceptre. Ankhu barefoot in 014/015 vs sandals 040/041; attendants barefoot fine.
evidence.cinematography: Foreground attendant cropped at bottom edge 040/041; 023 close-up crops feet; overhead cam 037-039 shrinks group; 042-047 cam6 strong gate composition with letterboxed fade 046-047; final title-plate cut 048 clean.
evidence.motion_fx: Same stride pose held across 040/041 on Anpu and Ankhu; Ankhu hop in 020; attendants' stiff A-pose repeated 042-045; foot dust unreadable at scale.
evidence.grounding: Tiny, floaty group in 037-039; attendant clips statue plinth 027/028 and 038; bodies overlap 034/035 and 043-046; shadows detached/too sharp vs painted pavement 040/043; blue-hood attendant stands inside brazier pedestal 042.
evidence.game_feel: Cam6 handover 042-045 converges group on doorway so destination reads; weak direction on the wide empty court 037-039; subtitles linger across cuts (039-041 same line).
evidence.ui_title: Gold serif logo and 001/003 menu hierarchy strong; menu text low-contrast/low-left and selection bar faint; subtitles 039-044 legible, centered, good size.
evidence.audio: From scripts only (walk_anpu_lines.json, walk_ankhu_lines.json), no timing data: strong, warm, restrained writing with clear arc grief -> name -> invitation; paired call-and-response and acting notes good; Ankhu has no cam6 line and Anpu cam5/cam6 lines overlap on the subtitle track.

defects.what: 3D characters are tiny/floaty, clip statue plinths and each other, and have detached shadows against painted plates, so they do not read as part of the world.
Film Anpu (gold regalia, large ankh, jackal-headed sceptre) does not match in-game Anpu (black leggings, tiny ankh, plain sceptre); Ankhu barefoot in 014/015 vs sandals in play.
Repeated stiff poses: Ankhu hop-run 020, frozen stride Anpu, static A-pose attendants; foot dust and contact cues unreadable, animation breaks the painterly mood.
